tool.name: TopAnat gene expression enrichment analysis of anatomical terms and cell types, mapped to genes by expression patterns
tool.description: Perform a gene expression enrichement analysis by providing a list of genes as foreground using Ensembl identifiers, and optionally a background list of genes to define your universe (by default, all genes in the considered species with expression data in Bgee will be used). Obtain as a result the list of anatomical entities and cell types that are over-associated with your gene list as compared to the universe, using signals of active expression to links genes to anatomical entities and cell types.
